CE.ui.row.title: Cursed Energy
CE.ui.badge.title: Cursed Energy ({path})
CE.ui.recompute.title: Recompute maximum from spell slots
CE.cast.highLevelUsed: [Cursed Energy] {actor} already cast a 6th-level or higher spell since the last long rest.
CE.rest.recoveredShort: Recovered {amount} CE on a short rest.
CE.rest.recoveredLong: Cursed Energy fully restored on a long rest.
CE.settings.resourcePath.name: Attribute path for CE
CE.settings.resourcePath.hint: Where the pool is stored on the actor. Default: system.resources.primary. Choose an unused resource: named resources such as Ki are protected from automatic conversion.
CE.settings.poolMultiplier.name: Pool multiplier
CE.settings.poolMultiplier.hint: The pool is the actor's real spell slots priced by the cost curve. 1.0 is parity with slots; lower it to tighten the table.
CE.settings.costCurve.name: Cost curve (JSON, levels 1-9)
CE.settings.costCurve.hint: CE cost of each spell level. It also prices the pool, so both sides stay in sync.
CE.settings.cantripCost.name: Cantrip cost (level 0)
CE.settings.ritualMult.name: Ritual cost multiplier
CE.settings.ritualMult.hint: Applied only when Cast as a ritual is checked in the usage dialog. Normal casting pays full cost even if the spell has the ritual property.
CE.settings.freeInnate.name: Innate and at-will spells are free
CE.settings.freeInnate.hint: Spells cast with the innate or at-will method never touch the pool.
CE.settings.freeScrolls.name: Spell scrolls are free
CE.settings.freeScrolls.hint: Casting from a scroll spends the scroll, not the caster's energy.
CE.settings.respectNoSlot.name: Respect activities that spend no slot
CE.settings.respectNoSlot.hint: An activity configured not to consume a spell slot does not consume CE either.
CE.settings.shortRestMode.name: Short rest recovery
CE.settings.shortRestMode.hint: Automatic returns the share of the pool that comes from short-rest slots (pact magic). Fixed uses the fraction below.
CE.settings.shortRest.name: Short rest fraction
CE.settings.shortRest.hint: Only used when recovery is set to a fixed fraction.
CE.settings.recoveryFeatures.name: Spell slot recovery features
CE.settings.recoveryFeatures.hint: Comma separated identifiers. Using one of these features pays out CE instead of the spell slots it would let you pick: half the class level in slot levels, nothing above 5th, priced by the cost curve.
CE.settings.highLevelLimit.name: One 6th-level or higher spell per long rest
CE.settings.highLevelLimit.hint: House rule: one spell of level 6 or higher in total per long rest. This is stricter than the DMG spell point variant.
CE.settings.slotGate.name: Keep the slot table as the level gate
CE.settings.slotGate.hint: On: spell slot maxima determine the available casting levels. Remaining slot counts are ignored, and slots are never spent. Off: CE does not enforce this extra level check.
CE.settings.forceByDefault.name: Use CE by default
CE.settings.forceByDefault.hint: Applies to every actor unless a sheet says otherwise.
CE.settings.announceInChat.name: Announce CE spending in chat
CE.settings.autoRecompute.name: Keep the maximum in step with the slots
CE.settings.autoRecompute.hint: Levelling up recomputes the pool and hands over the energy it gained, with no button to press.
CE.settings.badge.name: Show CE badge in the sheet header
CE.settings.badge.hint: Off by default: the meter already shows the pool, and two counters on one sheet is one too many.
CE.settings.meterLocation.name: Where the CE meter goes
CE.settings.meterLocation.hint: CE is a mana pool, so it sits in the spell tab by default: after the spellcasting cards, above the search bar.
CE.settings.hideSlotsGlobal.name: Hide spell slots on sheets
CE.settings.hideSlotsGlobal.hint: Visual only: the slots stay in the data, untouched.
CE.settings.autoMapBar2.name: Map token bar 2 to CE
CE.settings.autoMapBar2.hint: Applied when the pool is recomputed or migrated, never on every actor update.
CE.menu.migrator.name: Migrate to Cursed Energy
CE.menu.migrator.label: Open migrator
CE.menu.migrator.hint: Set the pool on every actor, hide slots and switch them to CE.
CE.menu.playground.name: Cursed Energy playground
CE.menu.playground.label: Open playground
CE.menu.playground.hint: See how the selected actor's pool is built, slot by slot.
CE.migrate.title: Migrate to Cursed Energy
CE.migrate.populate.label: Set CE on every actor (derived from their spell slots)
CE.migrate.hideSlots.label: Hide spell slots on sheets
CE.migrate.force.label: Use CE instead of spell slots
CE.play.title: Cursed Energy — Playground
CE.play.pickActor: Select a token or assign a character first.
CE.item.override.label: [Cursed Energy] CE cost (override)
CE.item.override.notes: Leave empty to use the curve. A value here replaces the calculated cost.
CE.commands.usage: Usage: /ce +N | -N | +10% | -25% | set N | max | recalc | show
CE.commands.noActor: Select a token or assign a character to use /ce.
CE.notify.poolRestored: Cursed Energy is derived from the spell slots, so the pool was put back ({max}).
CE.ui.section.title: Extensions
CE.settings.singleSection.name: Spellbook as a single section
CE.settings.singleSection.hint: One pool means no slot levels to keep apart: every spell lands in one list and the per-level headers (1st, 2nd, ... with Time, Range, Target, Roll) go away. Turn it off for tables that want the sheet the way the system draws it.
CE.settings.sectionLabel.name: Name of that section
CE.cast.ritualHint: Use only if the character can cast this spell as a ritual. Uses the ritual cost multiplier, at the base spell level. Casting time is managed by the table.
CE.cast.ritualUpcast: [Cursed Energy] Rituals must use the base spell level.
CE.cast.levelUnavailable: [Cursed Energy] This character has no spell slot progression for level {level}.
CE.settings.invalidCurve: [Cursed Energy] Invalid cost curve. Use a JSON object with levels 1–9 and finite nonnegative numeric costs. The previous valid curve is retained; missing levels use defaults.
CE.commands.failed: [Cursed Energy] Could not update this actor. Check ownership permissions.
CE.migrate.conflicts: Skipped {count} actors because the selected resource already stores another resource. Choose an unused resource path before migrating.
